Compact Groundcar. Upgrades: TUp (+1 SP) Armored Chassis, Autopilot Terminal, Bulletproof Glass [x2], Bulwark Armor [x2], Combat Plow, TUp (Self-Driving Vehicle) Communications Center, CrystalDome, TUp (+30 SDP) Heavy Chassis, Hover Upgrade, NOS [x4], Reinforced Tires, Sealed Environment, Smuggling Upgrade [x2]. Fills a 6×6m area and hovers 1m up, ignoring small obstacles and rough ground. Rear cargo hold for 2 tons. Autopilot at Skill Base 14. Everyone plugged in counts as both driver and passenger, so two crew give it two Actions and two Move Actions, mounts included.

Cost: 85,000eb
Nomad: 9
SDP: 100
SP: 18
Seats: 2
MOVE: 15
Speed: 75 mph
